simple.meaning: דֹּתָן (Dôthân) is a Hebrew word meaning “Dothan , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דֹּתָן (H1886) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 37:17, with occurrences in Genesis, 2 Kings.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֹּתָן (H1886) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דֹּתָן (H1886) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דֹּתָן (Dôthân) / H1886 is traced through Genesis 37:17, 2 Kings 6:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
